title: users/{uid}
description: A cubetrace account's record in Firestore, schema version 1 (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §10): what the app writes at each sign-in, merged into the document, so that devices accumulates every device's entry.

createdMs.description: When the account was created: Firebase Authentication's creation time of the account, in ms since 1970-01-01 UTC. The same on every device, so every sign-in writes the value already there.

displayName.description: The account's name, as Google gives it; null without one.

email.description: The account's email address, as Google gives it; null without one.

devices.description: The devices the account was used on, by host label (Settings → This device; session.json's host.label): each one's host clock, in ms, when it last signed in or started signed in.
